stories.title: Parents’ lawyers give Flintshire Council 24 hours to reveal true cost of £55m Catholic super-school plan
stories.summary: An eight-page legal letter by parents is demanding Flintshire Council answers key questions and provides a full updated cost for its Catholic super-school plan by tomorrow. stories.title: Dog exercise paddock owner to appeal after Flintshire planning committee refuses Penymynydd scheme
stories.summary: The owner of a proposed dog exercise facility which has failed to secure planning permission says he will appeal as he cannot understand why his plans have been refused. stories.title: Electricity bill tax cut expected to take around £45 a year off household bills
stories.summary: VAT on household electricity bills will be scrapped from 1 October, a change the UK government estimates will take around £45 a year off a typical bill for homes across Flintshire. stories.title: Meningitis B vaccine rollout begins for young people in Wales
stories.summary: Young people in Wales are being offered the meningitis B vaccine from today as part of a nationwide rollout ahead of the new academic year. stories.title: Airbus lands 100-aircraft order for jets built with Broughton wings
stories.summary: SMBC Aviation Capital has placed a firm order for 100 Airbus A320neo family aircraft. The order, made up of 65 A321neo and 35 A320neo jets, was finalised at the Farnborough International Airshow. Airbus Broughton, manufactures the wings for the A320 family.
